plc.text: The Weaver King, born Oleg il-Dal, is imprisoned and experimented on by Volrath, which drives him mad, and when Volrath puts a mother and child in the labyrinth, Oleg kills the child and possesses the mother, becoming the Weaver King.

Brought to Urborg with the Stronghold during the Rathi Overlay, he weaves a web of mental strands for 300 years and torments Venser, and he follows Jodah and Venser to Skyshroud, where he takes control of the slivers and Phyrexians.
Venser tricks the Weaver King and kills him by planeswalking while holding a pair of powerstones.
